ANALYTICAL RECORD / VERSION 0.1.0

From locus candidates to a core-like probability

The pipeline preserves effect direction, keeps missing network pairs distinct from negative evidence, and collapses correlated evidence from the same physical source locus conservatively.

  1. 01Ascertain

    LDL lead loci; L2G ≥ 0.40 plus verified seed genes.

  2. 02Harmonize

    Signed alleles; CAD effects scaled to genotype SD.

  3. 03Estimate

    Single-instrument full-delta Wald ratios.

  4. 04Collapse

    Maximum edge probability within each 1 Mb source locus.

  5. 05Integrate

    Spike–slab evidence plus exact Poisson-binomial convergence.

Analysis funnelcount

Interpretive boundary

What this dashboard does not establish

  • Genome-wide gene→CAD colocalization was not available.
  • Network estimates reuse overlapping eQTLGen cohorts; unknown covariance is set to zero.
  • Whole blood is the discovery tissue; liver is audited only at the SORT1 region.
  • The universe is LDL-locus candidates, not all protein-coding genes.

Use these results to prioritize follow-up experiments, not as clinical guidance or definitive causal confirmation.
